subtasks.title: Write acceptance tests for render_inmemory_spec_sections and _render_spec_sections refactor (REQ-6)

subtasks.title: Write ID cross-reference consistency tests (REQ-7)

subtasks.title: Implement Requirement mapping loop (AcceptanceCriterion → Requirement)
details: Iterate over triage_result.criteria with enumerate(start=1); guard each field access with `field or ''` to satisfy 01-REQ-1.E2.
Set Requirement.id = f'NS-REQ-{n}', Requirement.title = criterion.description or '', Requirement.user_story = criterion.description or '' (verbatim, no template).
Construct exactly one acceptance criterion entry from criterion.preconditions and criterion.expected and set Requirement.acceptance_criteria = [that entry].
Set Requirement.edge_cases = [].
Collect all Requirement objects into a Requirements(items=[...]) instance.

subtasks.title: Implement TestCase derivation loop (AcceptanceCriterion → TestCase)
details: Iterate over triage_result.criteria with enumerate(start=1); guard each field with `field or ''`.
Set TestCase.id = f'TS-NS-{n}', TestCase.requirement_id = f'NS-REQ-{n}'.

Set TestCase.description = criterion.description or '', TestCase.preconditions = criterion.preconditions or [], TestCase.expected = criterion.expected or '', TestCase.assertion_pseudocode = criterion.assertion or ''.
Set TestCase.input = '' and TestCase.kind = 'acceptance'.
Collect all TestCase objects into a TestSpec(items=[...]) instance.

subtasks.title: Implement TaskGroup and Subtask construction
details: Iterate over triage_result.criteria with enumerate(start=1) to build one Subtask per criterion.

Set Subtask.id = f'1.{n}', Subtask.title = criterion.description or '', Subtask.details = [str(criterion.preconditions or ''), criterion.expected or '', criterion.assertion or ''], Subtask.state = SubtaskState.PENDING, Subtask.test_spec_refs = [f'TS-NS-{n}'], Subtask.requirement_refs = [f'NS-REQ-{n}'].
When criteria list is empty, produce one fallback Subtask: id='1.1', title='Fix the issue', details=[], state=SubtaskState.PENDING, test_spec_refs=[], requirement_refs=[].
Wrap subtasks in a single TaskGroup(id=1, kind='tests', title=f'Fix issue #{issue_number}', subtasks=[...]).
Wrap the TaskGroup in Tasks(groups=[task_group]).

subtasks.title: Implement PRDDocument construction and assemble final Spec
details: Construct PRDFrontmatter(spec_id=f'fix-{issue_number}', spec_name=f'fix_issue_{issue_number}'); leave all other fields at Pydantic defaults.
Construct PRDDocument(frontmatter=frontmatter, body=triage_result.issue_body or '').
Assemble and return Spec(requirements=requirements, test_spec=test_spec, tasks=tasks, prd=prd).
Confirm no calls to afspec.load_spec(), afspec.save(), or builtins.open anywhere in this function.
